constraints: The BLOB's data must already be laid out to match the destination variable's type/size (typically written earlier via VARIABLE TO BLOB); mismatched data produces undefined results.
If offset is omitted, variable data is read starting at the beginning of the BLOB (offset 0).

overloadMerges.note: variable is documented/arrow-marked as an output ('<-', the command overwrites it), and offset is inout ('<->': input starting byte position, output updated to the position just after the read) -- both were defaulted to direction:in by the draft parser.

params.name: variable
params.description: Overwritten with the data read from blob.

params.name: offset
params.description: Byte position within blob to read variable from; on return, updated to the position of the next variable within the BLOB.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Reads variable's data out of blob at the given (or default) byte offset, advancing offset past the value read.
